summary.text: Mark McConkey is a Republican state senator from New Hampshire who has represented District 3 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: McConkey earned a bachelor's degree from Springfield College, and his career experience includes owning and operating a business.
He has served on the Lakes Region Planning Commission Executive Board and as the chairman of the Ossipee Zoning Board of Adjustment.
McConkey served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2002 to 2018, representing Carroll 3, and again from 2020 to 2024, and assumed office in the State Senate on December 4, 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Capital Budget Committee, is vice chair of the Senate Transportation Committee, and serves on the Energy and Natural Resources and Senate Judiciary committees.
